boundCohort.interpretationConstraint: The four-record cohort was selected because each record previously produced at least one MAX_TOKENS serialization failure under thinkingLevel=medium. Therefore serializationSuccessRate is conditional on prior failure and is not an estimate of general verifier serialization reliability, future catalogue reliability, population performance, or production reliability.

callLimitsAndExecutionPlan.failureClassification: If any call experiences provider/transport error unrelated to token budget, classify as TECHNICAL_TRANSPORT_FAILURE without silent rerun.

costGovernance.costArithmetic: Sum of 4 candidate inputs (13,139 tokens @ $0.75/MTok = $0.00985425) + 4 x 6,144 maxOutputTokens saturation (24,576 tokens @ $3.75/MTok = $0.09216000) = theoretical maximum $0.10201425 USD. Governed ceiling set at $0.150000 USD (incorporating ~47% safety margin).

comparativeMetrics: medium malformed-attempt count vs low malformed-attempt count
medium thoughtsTokenCount range vs low thoughtsTokenCount
medium candidatesTokenCount range vs low candidatesTokenCount
endpoints.endpointSeparation: Schema validity and semantic validity do not determine the primary technicalSerializationSuccess endpoint. They are reported separately as observational diagnostics.
endpoints.primaryEndpoint: technicalSerializationSuccess = response reaches complete parseable JSON payload without finishReason=MAX_TOKENS
endpoints.scoringRule: Semantic disposition is strictly observational. Do NOT score semantic accuracy against human labels.

experimentalDelta.description: Single-variable configuration delta: thinkingLevel changed from medium to low. All other model parameters, prompts, schemas, input packets, and output validators remain byte-identical.

researchQuestion: Does changing Gemini 3.8 Flash from thinkingLevel=medium to thinkingLevel=low reduce or eliminate MAX_TOKENS JSON truncation for the known v1.3 technical-failure records, while holding all semantic inputs and generation contracts constant?
stopRules: prompt or request hash differs from registered candidate request except for thinkingLevel delta
title: Candidate Verifier v1.3 Low-Thinking Technical Ablation Protocol
